description: Send the user's own candidacy for an open mission, on the mission's stated terms (hours, hourly rate). It binds nobody: the rikma's members sign it, discuss it or counter it, and silence approves it when the rikma's clock runs out. BEFORE calling, read the mission name, hours and rate back to the user and get their yes - then pass confirmedWithUser: true. When the mission is part of a customer's deal, every customer of that deal must sign too: the first call returns needsCustomerSignature and applies nothing; tell the user, and call again with customerSignatureUnderstood: true only if they still want to. To propose different terms, give the user the mission page instead. Ids come from listMyMatchesTool or searchCatalogTool. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#applyToMissionTool

confirmedWithUser.description: true only after the user heard the mission name, hours and rate and said yes.

customerSignatureUnderstood.description: true only after the user was told the deal's customers must also sign, and still wants to apply.

name: applyToMissionTool
